title: Ecos-Synthetica
one_line: One living world, three ways to learn it: Eco Explorer (Class 1-10), Eco Scientist (Class 11-12) and Eco Professional, in English, Hindi and Bengali.
how_to_play: Tap Play on a path. Explorer: tap where to go and follow the voice. Scientist: move with the joystick or WASD, tap an organism to scan it, L opens the Lab. Professional: read the case, choose your plan, run the model. A new nature question every day.
description: Start as an Eco Explorer: plant trees, rescue animals, clean the river, sort waste and light the village, with picture questions read aloud so Class 1-3 can play without reading. Grow into an Eco Scientist: live as a cell, a plant, a bee and a human, meet 42 organisms from their own side first, answer them the way life really does in the Synthesis Lab, then run experiments on population growth, predators and prey, the carbon and nitrogen cycles, keep a journal and ask the AI Teacher. Work as an Eco Professional on real cases: a dengue outbreak, city air quality, village water, a net-zero ward, monsoon drains, urea for wheat, drip irrigation, a tiger reserve and mangroves before a cyclone, then Research mode with Census, tiger and CO2 data. Every science claim is sourced, with Indian history and examples. A daily question builds a streak. Teachers can collect report cards. Works offline once loaded; nothing is tracked.
